messages:
maya: Heads-up — the cost dashboard is showing negative cache savings for tenant `acme-inc` on the /nlp/summarize route yesterday. Numbers look doubled. Anyone else see this? :eyes:
jonathan: whoa. can you paste the panel query or a screenshot?
maya: attaching snippet (copied from the debug view):
```
SELECT tenant_id, route, sum(cache_credit) as credit
FROM billing.prefetch_credits
WHERE day = '2026-03-20'
GROUP BY tenant_id, route;
```
maya: credit for /nlp/summarize = -248.3, then another row for same tenant+route = -247.9 (so total ~ -496)
li: that looks like double-counting across two pipelines. did we run the prefetched-credit join twice in the nightly job?
ops-bot: deploy 17298.41 completed to prod at 2026-03-20T23:47:12Z (change: routing-priority-fallback). :rocket:
sophie: routing-priority-fallback was the change that toggled retries to fallback model B when A is overloaded, right? Could be duplicate crediting if both A and B record prefetch hits.
amanda: yep. I briefly dug in — our cache-credit attribution keys are model+route+prompt-fingerprint, but we don't include the resolved model variant id, so fallback requests can re-credit the same prompt under a different model key.
jonathan: so the same invocation could create two separate negative credits if both A and B record a prefetch hit and then the pipeline aggregates them?
amanda: exactly. the aggregator expects unique request ids but prefetch writes aren't deduped end-to-end.
li: quick mitigation: cap per-tenant per-route delta to 0 in the dashboard until we fix the upstream dedupe? or show a warning badge that sample may be inflated.
sophie: would prefer guardrail in billing pipeline rather than just UI mask. a cap could hide real refunds.
maya: agreed — but customer facing invoices must not show negative savings. Can we clamp display to min(0, savings) in the invoice preview and still surface raw values in the internal debug view?
jonathan: proposal: 1) temp clamp in invoice preview + add warning; 2) create dedupe ticket to include request_guid in prefetch write; 3) add resolved_model_variant to cache-credit key to avoid double-counting.
amanda: sounds good. for (2) we need one more change: the routing service currently assigns request_guid before we decide fallback, so we should propagate the same guid across retries (we don't right now).
li: on the logs I saw retries generate new guids, which is the root cause. we can propagate X-Request-GUID on the retry flow. small change in router.
sophie: UX ask: add a toggle on the cost dashboard to "include fallback duplicates" OR "dedup across model variants" so platform folks can switch while we test. keeps data transparent.
maya: +1 to the toggle. add a tooltip: "When on, the view deduplicates cache credits across resolved model variants."
amanda: action items: AMANDA -> add resolved_model_variant to credit key + update aggregator dedupe logic; LI -> router change to propagate request_guid on retries; JONATHAN -> add UI toggle and clamp for invoice previews; MAYA -> customer comms draft if we need to explain billing blip.
jonathan: I'll wire the toggle as a checkbox in the Cost Settings panel, default OFF, with link to internal debug raw-values view. frontend effort ~1d + backend flag.
ops-bot: ticket created ENG-4501: propagate-request-guid-on-retries (assignee: li). ticket created ENG-4502: dedupe-cache-credits-by-variant (assignee: amanda). ticket created ENG-4503: cost-ui-dedupe-toggle-and-clamp (assignee: jonathan).
maya: thanks. can someone also drop a quick query we can run to validate fix once deployed? maybe look for duplicates in prefetch_credits by tenant+route+prompt_fingerprint across day boundary.
li: will add a validation job that flags >1 credits for same prompt_fingerprint within 5m window.
sophie: fwiw we should add an alert to the cost-dashboard channel if negative-savings > 1% of daily token spend for a tenant. catches regressions.
amanda: noted. I'll add an emitted metric from the aggregator when dedupe rate > 0.1% so alerts can be configured.
maya: great. thanks folks. follow-ups: ENG-4501/4502/4503. I'll post a short customer note if we see invoice previews already generated. :thumbsup:
